Data: 22 October 2026
Destinatário: Ms Jane Example / Example Family Office / Avenida Exemplo 1, Lisbon
Assunto: Invitation to the Wealth and Migration Summit 2026
Saudação: Dear Ms Example,

Corpo:
On behalf of Global Citizen Solutions, I would like to invite you to the Wealth and Migration Summit 2026, which takes place in Lisbon on 5 and 6 November 2026 at the EPIC SANA Marques Hotel. The Summit is a private gathering for families, advisers and institutions working at the point where international wealth and global mobility meet.

Attendance is limited to 200 attendees. Over two days the programme brings together 26 speakers and 10 workshops, so that investment selection, legal structuring, tax planning, banking and long-term mobility can be discussed in one room and in a fixed sequence rather than one specialist at a time.

We believe your work with international families makes you a natural participant in these conversations, and we would be glad to welcome you personally. If it is helpful, we can arrange a short call beforehand to walk you through the two days and to answer any questions about the format of the workshops.

Should you wish to bring a colleague or a client, please let us know in your reply so that we can reserve the places in good time. Because the number of seats is limited, we ask that you confirm your intention to attend as soon as it is convenient for you.

We would also be pleased to hear which topics matter most to you and your clients, as this helps us to shape the workshop discussions and to make sure the time you spend with us is as useful as possible.

Thank you for your time and for considering our invitation. I look forward to hearing from you and, I hope, to welcoming you in Lisbon in November.

Fecho: Yours sincerely,
Assinatura: Alex Sample / Head of Partnerships
